title: Pocket Fuel Fruit Bomb Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Rich, red berries put the fruit in Pocket Fuel’s delicious Fruit Bomb e-liquid, joined by bracing menthol and spicy aniseed. This fabulous combination of flavours produce an e-liquid bursting with flavour, character and satisfaction. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape to your liking. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered mods and sub-ohm tanks .
